column5: AuthPluginDescriptor/AuthPluginRegistry preserve Go validateAuthPlugin's empty-name, duplicate, reserved built-in, and required AuthenticateUser/GenerateAuthString/ValidateAuthString checks; AuthPluginAdmission and ClientPluginSelection classify built-in/custom/unsupported names, native fallback, LDAP/custom client mappings, and legacy-client rejection without executing callbacks; password hashing/verification, extension setup, and privilege integration remain open.
